headline: Quiet Saturday; scores drift as last week's news settles
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Scores shifted only by hundredths as the effects of earlier announcements faded: Gatekeeper ticked up slightly while Self-Destruction and the AI-takeover endings eased. Zookeeper keeps its Breakout badge from a strong week. Horizon Balance is 0.4, up 0.02.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; Gatekeeper +0.0 led a small fading-driven drift.
